page: Microsoft Azure M32bs_v3 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C processor with 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 4.0 GHz. The processor includes a 105 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for accelerated vector and matrix operations. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, but contains no local storage, relying instead on external premium block storage.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance in specific single-threaded and multi-threaded operations. The server achieves top-tier results in Geekbench single-core scoring (2210.0), image processing (17544.0), and text processing (2768.0). Single-threaded gzip compression (33.05 GB/sec) and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (210.74 GB/sec) are also rated as strong. For memory-bound tasks, the instance delivers a cached read-only small block memory bandwidth of 2764.98 GB/sec, though uncached large block write bandwidth drops to 86.71 GB/sec. In database and transactional tests, the system processes 44.24 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 17240.94 on Passmark database operations.

The M32bs_v3 offers high resource density with its 256.0 GB memory allocation, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. However, a notable tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, requiring external block storage configurations which may introduce latency depending on the storage tier selected. Additionally, while the server demonstrates top-tier performance in small-model LLM text generation (343.5 tokens/sec for a 135M model), it exhibits weak performance for large-scale AI workloads, processing only 2.74 tokens/sec on a 70B model due to the lack of dedicated GPU hardware. This profile makes the instance highly suitable for memory-optimized databases, enterprise application servers, web serving, and moderate data processing tasks.
